overall_reason: A complete shadcn and Tailwind v4 token layer with a parallel dark theme exists, but the page's own hero, buttons and background bypass it with bracketed hex values, and the brand blue and ink each run in three or four values.

score.reason: T-HARDCODE fails on the CTA fill and page background (bg-[#1d4ed8], bg-[#f8fafc]) and T-VALUE-INVENTORY on the brand blue and ink; T-SCALE-FIT and T-THEME-PARITY pass (TOK-006, TOK-001).

findings.where: header and hero buttons, page wrapper, logo wordmark; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: declarations.arbitrary_value_selectors lists 14 bracketed one-offs on the page's own components: .bg-[#1d4ed8] on 'Get started' and 'Find my AI stack', .bg-[#f8fafc] on div.min-h-screen, .text-[#1d4ed8], .bg-[#172033], .text-[17px], .text-[10px], .text-[11px], .rounded-[2rem]. The shadcn layer declares --primary, --background and --foreground (19 of 20 roles) beside them.
findings.before: Primary buttons and page background typed as hex in class names
findings.after: bg-primary, bg-background and text-foreground from the existing token layer; drop the bracketed hex classes
findings.why: The dark theme redefines --primary and --background, but the bracketed hex does not follow it, so these components would stay light-mode blue and off-white in dark mode.
findings.root: hex utility classes on the shared button and page wrapper

findings.where: eyebrows, step numbers, CTAs and headings; 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png, tiles/1440-01.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.colour_text shows the brand blue in three values (#155dfc on the 'HOW IT WORKS' eyebrow and step numbers, #1447e6 once, #1d4ed8 once) and fills add #1d4ed8 on the CTAs and #2b7fff on an avatar. Ink runs as #172033 (wordmark, 9 elements), #020618, #0f172b and #1d293d; nav text uses #314158, #62748e and #45556c.
findings.before: Brand blue in 3 to 4 values and dark text in 4 values across 98 elements; 9 of 16 text colours are one-offs
findings.after: One --primary for every brand-blue job and one --foreground ink, with --muted-foreground for secondary text
findings.why: Same-job text drifts between Tailwind slate steps and a custom ink, so no single token governs the brand colour.

findings.where: logo wordmark against hero lead; cards against panels; 1440
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size.near_duplicates pairs 17px (span.text-[17px], the wordmark) with 18px (hero lead, 5 elements). colour_fill.near_duplicates pairs #ffffff (9) with #f8fafc (2), 0.016 OKLab apart, on cards and the inner hero panel.
findings.before: 17 and 18px side by side; #ffffff and #f8fafc surfaces
findings.after: Wordmark on the 18px step; one card surface token
findings.why: Values a hair apart read as accidents, not choices.

strengths: A dark theme that swaps the same names: 26 of 27 semantic colour tokens are redefined, the media query and .dark class mirror each other (33 in both), and dark rules use var() only.
Spacing sits on the framework's 4px base (100% on 4px, 97% of spacing declarations use var(--spacing)).
not_investigated: The dark theme was read from the stylesheet only; the capture renders the light scheme.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (AI tool recommender landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
